mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during monetary easing cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a deepening economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 35% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC is negative in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.0% signals a supply shock regime that increases inflationary pressures and reduces corporate output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 35% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is negative in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates improving economic conditions that boost corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during labor market expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 30% of instances where both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC is negative in 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion regime defined by housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1500 thousand units and real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% year-over-year causes overvaluation and policy tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 35% of instances meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.
